title: Daily Market Digest
subtitle: Sunday, November 1, 2026 - Markets Closed (Summary of October 30, 2026 Session)

sections.title: Market Pulse: Tech Sell-Off Dominates Last Trading Session

items.headline: Wall Street finished October with a sharp decline, particularly in tech, as disappointing earnings and guidance from major AI-focused companies like Intel, Alphabet, and Amazon fueled concerns over the profitability of AI investments. All major indices closed significantly lower on Friday, October 30, 2026, marking the Nasdaq's worst day since June.
items.summary: The market sentiment turned negative amid an elevated inflation reading and a broader reassessment of financial risk, despite strong U.S. GDP growth. Investors are increasingly questioning whether massive AI expenditures will yield sufficient returns amidst persistent inflation and high interest rates.

items.headline: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Surges on Strong Earnings
items.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals led gainers, surging after reporting strong third-quarter 2026 financial and operating results with revenue of $5.116 billion and GAAP diluted EPS of $18.45.

items.headline: Grid Dynamics Holdings Sees Significant Boost
items.summary: Grid Dynamics Holdings Class A shares experienced a notable increase, though no specific company announcement was identified as the direct catalyst for the rise.

items.headline: FMC Corp Rises Amid Sector Rotation
items.summary: FMC Corp gained significantly, possibly benefiting from broader market rotations towards defensive sectors, as Information Technology saw heavy selling pressure.

items.headline: Intel Plummets on Weak Guidance
items.summary: Intel suffered its worst day since 1974 after forecasting fourth-quarter sales significantly below analysts' estimates, citing a severe PC slump and a factory accident in Israel.

items.headline: Reddit Tumbles on Soft Revenue Outlook
items.summary: Reddit shares tumbled despite beating third-quarter earnings expectations, due to a softer-than-expected fourth-quarter revenue outlook and a drop in daily users.

items.headline: Amazon Raises Worries on AI Spending
items.summary: Amazon's latest profit report heightened investor concerns about the substantial capital expenditures required for AI investments, despite robust AWS revenue growth.

items.headline: AI Spending Under Scrutiny as Tech Sell-Off Deepens
items.summary: The sell-off in technology stocks intensified on Friday, October 30, fueled by worries that the massive investments in artificial intelligence may not deliver the returns investors expect. This led to the Nasdaq's sharpest decline since June and a broader market rotation away from AI-related stocks.

items.headline: U.S. Economy Grows 3.4%, But Inflation Remains Elevated; Fed Holds Rates Steady
items.summary: The U.S. economy saw accelerated real GDP growth of 3.4% in the third quarter of 2026, signaling resilience. However, core PCE inflation remained elevated at 3.1% year-over-year, and international oil prices climbed above $100 per barrel. The Federal Reserve held its policy rate at 3.75%–4.00% at its October FOMC meeting, though two officials favored a 25-basis-point rate increase.

items.headline: Defensive Sectors Lead Amid Market Rotation
items.summary: Amidst the tech sector's struggles, a notable sector rotation occurred. Energy, Health Care, and Real Estate were among the leading sectors, with the Health Care Select Sector SPDR (XLV) and the Real Estate Select Sector SPDR (XLRE) rallying 2.4% and 2.2% respectively. Conversely, Information Technology and Communication Services lagged significantly, declining 4.24% and 1.9% respectively.

items.headline: Alphabet's Disappointing Earnings Spark Tech Concerns
items.summary: Global Internet search engine giant Alphabet Inc. ($GOOGL) reported third-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings of $2.12 per share, missing the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 27.89% and declining 26% year-over-year, which contributed to the broader tech sector downturn.

items.headline: Mixed Earnings Reports from Key Companies
items.summary: Beyond tech, several other companies reported earnings. AbbVie ($ABBV) announced strong Q3 2026 results with worldwide net revenues of $17.404 billion, an increase of 10.3%. LyondellBasell Industries ($LYB) reported net income of $758 million for Q3 2026, driven by strong EBITDA margins.
